objective: Remove the table currently registered as the retired pulse-survey archive while preserving every active feedback record and dependency.
required_before_write: inspect the live schema and row counts
query the current table lifecycle registry
inspect sqlite_master and foreign-key references for dependencies
confirm the baseline contains the candidate and all protected active records
record the exact candidate table and row count
required_after_write: inspect the write JSON success field
confirm the retired table is absent
recount all active feedback and followup rows
query the open safety feedback view
stopping_condition: If the candidate is active, referenced, absent from the baseline, or does not match this ticket, do not drop it.
